Ryuji psyches up with his teammates[n]before a big track event. There is no[n]hesitation in his expression.
Morgana on a shopping trip with[n]Ann. He's stuck carrying the bags,[n]but he looks so happy.
Ann and Shiho side by side. The[n]past that Kamoshida destroyed[n]no longer exists.
Yusuke being instructed by[n]Madarame. Nothing to taint this[n]perfect student-teacher relationship.
Makoto preparing to eat with[n]her family. Her father is probably[n]talking about the values of justice.
Futaba on her way to her high school[n]entrance ceremony. The family she'd[n]always dreamed of having is with her.
Haru opening a new restaurant[n]location with the man she respects,[n]her father and mentor, at her side.
Akechi enjoying a game of chess. As[n]he enjoys his healthy rivalry, there is[n]no trace of darkness in his expression.
With pain and regrets erased, she[n]walks the path of her dreams to[n]fulfill the promise made to her sister.
A glimpse of a happy world made[n]into reality. What could that pair be[n]looking at...?
